service.description: Implements standard MCP tools/list by scanning all active components for service definitions under mcp/tools/** and transforming in-parameters into JSON Schema parameter definitions.

parameter.name: domain
parameter.description: Optional filter by tool domain/subfolder (e.g. screen, entity, service)

parameter.name: tools
parameter.description: List of MCP Tool definitions with JSON Schema input definitions

actions.script:
import java.io.File import java.nio.file.Path import groovy.io.FileType import groovy.util.Node import groovy.xml.XmlParser
List toolList = [] File compBase = new File("runtime/component")
def mapMoquiTypeToJsonType = { String type -> if (!type) return "string" switch (type.toLowerCase()) { case 'integer': case 'long': case 'biginteger': return "integer" case 'number': case 'float': case 'double': case 'bigdecimal': return "number" case 'boolean': return "boolean" case 'list': return "array" case 'map': return "object" default: return "string" } }
if (compBase.exists() && compBase.isDirectory()) { compBase.eachDir { File compDir -> String cName = compDir.name if (targetComponent && cName != targetComponent) return
File toolsDir = new File(compDir, "mcp/tools") if (toolsDir.exists() && toolsDir.isDirectory()) { Path basePath = toolsDir.toPath()
toolsDir.eachFileRecurse(FileType.FILES) { File f -> if (!f.name.endsWith(".xml") || f.name.startsWith(".")) return
Path relPath = basePath.relativize(f.toPath()) String relPathStr = relPath.toString().replace('\\', '/') String[] segments = relPathStr.split('/') String toolDomain = segments.length > 1 ? segments[0] : "general"
if (domain && toolDomain != domain) return
try { Node rootNode = new XmlParser(false, false).parse(f) if (rootNode.name() == 'services') { rootNode.children().each { serviceNode -> if (serviceNode instanceof Node && serviceNode.name() == 'service') { String verb = serviceNode.attribute('verb') ?: '' String noun = serviceNode.attribute('noun') ?: '' String serviceName = "${verb}#${noun}" String toolIdentifier = "${cName}__${toolDomain}__${verb}_${noun}"
String docText = "" Node descNode = serviceNode.children().find { it instanceof Node && it.name() == 'description' } if (descNode) docText = descNode.text().trim().replaceAll('\\s+', ' ')
Map properties = [:] List requiredFields = []
Node inParamsNode = serviceNode.children().find { it instanceof Node && it.name() == 'in-parameters' } if (inParamsNode) { inParamsNode.children().each { paramNode -> if (paramNode instanceof Node && paramNode.name() == 'parameter') { String pName = paramNode.attribute('name') String pType = paramNode.attribute('type') ?: 'String' String isReq = paramNode.attribute('required') String pDesc = ""
Node pDescNode = paramNode.children().find { it instanceof Node && it.name() == 'description' } if (pDescNode) pDesc = pDescNode.text().trim().replaceAll('\\s+', ' ')
properties[pName] = [ type: mapMoquiTypeToJsonType(pType), description: pDesc ]
if ("true".equalsIgnoreCase(isReq)) { requiredFields.add(pName) } } } }
toolList.add([ name: toolIdentifier, description: docText ?: "Moqui service tool ${serviceName} in ${cName}", component: cName, domain: toolDomain, serviceCallName: "${serviceNode.attribute('name') ?: serviceName}", filePath: "component://${cName}/mcp/tools/${relPathStr}", inputSchema: [ type: "object", properties: properties, required: requiredFields ] ]) } } } } catch (Exception parseEx) { ec.logger.warn("⚠️ [get#ToolList] Could not parse tool XML ${f.path}: ${parseEx.message}") } } } } }
context.tools = toolList ec.logger.info("🛠️ [get#ToolList] Discovered ${toolList.size()} dynamic MCP tools")

service.description: Executes a dynamically discovered MCP tool by resolving its component, file path, and target Moqui service call definition.

parameter.name: arguments
parameter.description: The argument map adhering to the tool's inputSchema
